package otel

import "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"

var (
	AttributeMatch       = attribute.Key("flipt.match")
	AttributeFlag        = attribute.Key("flipt.flag")
	AttributeFlagEnabled = attribute.Key("flipt.flag_enabled")
	AttributeSegment     = attribute.Key("flipt.segment")
	AttributeReason      = attribute.Key("flipt.reason")
	AttributeValue       = attribute.Key("flipt.value")
	AttributeEntityID    = attribute.Key("flipt.entity_id")
	AttributeRequestID   = attribute.Key("flipt.request_id")
)

#     eviction_interval: 5m # Evict Expired Items Every 5m

# server:

#     port: 6831

# meta:
#   check_for_updates: true

cache:
  enabled: true
  backend: memory
  ttl: 60s
  memory:
    eviction_interval: 5m # Evict Expired Items Every 5m

server:
  protocol: https
  host: 127.0.0.1
  http_port: 8081
  https_port: 8080
  grpc_port: 9001
  cert_file: "./testdata/ssl_cert.pem"
  cert_key: "./testdata/ssl_key.pem"

tracing:
  jaeger:
    enabled: true

db:
  url: postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/flipt?sslmode=disable
  max_idle_conn: 10
  max_open_conn: 50
  conn_max_lifetime: 30m

meta:
  check_for_updates: false
  telemetry_enabled: false

authentication:
  required: true
  session:
    domain: "auth.flipt.io"
    secure: true
    csrf:
      key: "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz1234567890" #gitleaks:allow
  methods:
    token:
      enabled: true
      cleanup:
         interval: 2h
         grace_period: 48h
    oidc:
      enabled: true
      providers:
        google:
          issuer_url: "http://accounts.google.com"
          client_id: "abcdefg"
          client_secret: "bcdefgh"

selection.summary: Issue: inconsistent tracing config caused by reliance on legacy tracing.jaeger.enabled. Fixed by unifying configuration following the existing cache deprecation pattern (h0, h2, h30, h31): internal/config/tracing.go (h7, h21, h28) now has top-level tracing.enabled and tracing.backend (new TracingBackend enum with a jaeger value, string decode hook, JSON marshaling); setDefaults maps legacy tracing.jaeger.enabled=true to tracing.enabled=true and tracing.backend=jaeger; a deprecations() method emits a warning pointing users to 'tracing.enabled'/'tracing.backend' (h2, h20). internal/cmd/grpc.go (h6, h17, h18, h22, h23) now gates the Jaeger exporter on cfg.Tracing.Enabled && cfg.Tracing.Backend == config.JaegerTracingBackend instead of cfg.Tracing.Jaeger.Enabled. internal/config/config.go (h1, h14, h15) registers stringToTracingBackend in the decode hooks; the reflection-driven deprecator/defaulters loops pick up the new TracingConfig methods automatically, matching the cache.memory.enabled precedent (h10 testdata fixture, config_test.go deprecation tests). Default config (h8) documents the new unified keys.
